_comment: Texture bindings for foliage whose FBX carries none at all. Synty's Nature Biomes packs export their card-based trees with a single gray Lambert over trunk and canopy alike, which texture_overrides.json cannot reach because there is no texture stem to key on. Keyed by pack folder name, then by a filename glob, then by part, first matching glob winning, so put the specific ones first. 'canopy' is the leaf cards, bound as a cutout; 'trunk' is the woody geometry they hang off, bound opaque; 'branches' is a separate twig mesh where a model has one. Values are path suffixes, as in texture_overrides.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored. See docs/geometry.md.
_verification: Canopy bindings were chosen by matching each pack's own LOD_Cards texture, a baked render of the finished tree, against every candidate leaf map, then confirmed by rendering. The method reproduces the two mappings already known independently: leafPatch_01 for the birches and pohutukawaLeaf for the pohutukawas. Trunk bindings were confirmed by sampling each candidate at the trunk's own UV coordinates, where a trunk collapses to a single point of the pack atlas holding its bark color. The birches are the exception, their trunks spanning a dedicated bark map.
_uncertain: leafPatch_02 against leafPatch_04 for SM_Env_Tree_Meadow_* is the one mapping with no decisive evidence; the two maps are near identical in palette and neither is bound by any model that kept its binding. The bushes are chosen by pack convention rather than by a card, since Synty ships no LOD card for them. Change either here and reconvert with --force.
